confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate for July 2026, made without checking live prices or listings. Restaurant and drink anchors are moderately reliable; hotel and hostel rates vary widely by district, season and booking date. The FX value came from a search summary attributed to the RBA exchange rates overview page. It was not confirmed in the RBA daily table or by a second search, so verify it before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. The estimates are Hong Kong-specific, informed by general price levels in other high-cost East Asian and Southeast Asian hub cities.
